text: Keep Awake 防休眠（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：在 agent 或后台任务运行时让电脑保持唤醒。它通过扫描运行中的 agent、后台 job 和可选的待执行定时任务，按需启动系统辅助进程，并在活动结束后经过可配置宽限期释放。主要功能包括显示活动与唤醒状态、手动保持、选择是否阻止屏幕关闭、设置定时任务保温和实时修改偏好。适合希望 DSH 长任务运行期间电脑不进入休眠的用户。需要 Node.js 22 以上；按平台使用 PowerShell、caffeinate 或 systemd-inhibit，不需要 API key 或外部账号。

Keep Awake 防休眠 is a DSH web plugin that keeps the computer awake during agent or background jobs, optionally scheduled tasks. It releases after a grace period. The web panel shows activity and offers manual hold and display settings. Requires Node.js 22+; PowerShell, caffeinate, or systemd-inhibit.

Can I keep my computer awake until scheduled DSH tasks have run?
How can I stop the display from turning off while an agent is working?
Keep Awake 防休眠 的功能「按活动状态保持唤醒」：检测运行中的 agent 与后台 job，并在需要时启动平台辅助进程。活动结束后按设置的宽限期释放唤醒状态。
Keep Awake 防休眠 的功能「定时任务保温」：开启设置后读取宿主的活动定时任务目录；只要存在待执行任务，就保持唤醒，并显示任务数量与最近执行时间。
Keep Awake 防休眠 的功能「Web 状态和控制」：设置页定时刷新活动计数、辅助进程和唤醒状态，并允许切换总开关、宽限期、屏幕保持、定时任务保温与手动保持。
Keep Awake 防休眠 使用前须知：需要系统提供对应的唤醒辅助工具；Windows 使用 PowerShell，macOS 使用 caffeinate，Linux 使用 systemd-inhibit。
让电脑在 DSH 的后台命令结束前一直保持唤醒。
I need a small web panel to check whether DSH is holding a wake lock.

dsh-keep-awake README · 功能总览：| 功能 | 位置 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 实时状态 | 设置页「防休眠」 | 状态徽章（保持唤醒中 / 宽限中 Ns / 待机 / 已停用 / 助手异常）、运行中 agent 数、后台任务数、辅助进程平台 + PID |
| 活动判定 | — | 运行中的 agent（主 agent / subagent / workflow 子代理）+ 运行中的后台任务（`run_in_background` 命令 / 后台 subagent 任务） |
| 宽限期 | 设置页可配 | 全部活动结束后 15s–5m（默认 60s）自动释放防休眠 |
| 手动保持 | 设置页 | 无视活动状态强制保持唤醒，点击取消 |
| 阻止屏幕关闭 | 设置页可选 | 默认只防系统休眠、允许熄屏；勾选后屏幕也保持 |
| 定时任务保温 | 设置页可选（默认关闭） | 开启后只要存在待执行的定时任务就保持唤醒，保证到点能触发；任务清空后按宽限期释放 |
| 多语言 | 全局 | 跟随 DSH 全局语言（zh/en），未显式设置时跟随浏览器/系统，切换即时生效（含侧边栏标签） |

dsh-keep-awake README · 工作原理：- **运行中的 agent**：`agents.list()` 中 `status === 'running'` 的 agent（覆盖主 agent、subagent、workflow 子代理）
- **后台任务**：`jobs.list()`（无归属任务）加上对每个活跃会话的 `jobs.list(sessionId)`，统计 `running`/`stopping` 的任务（覆盖 `run_in_background` 命令与后台 subagent 任务）；任务事件来自 `jobs.events.subscribe({ owners: 'all' }, ...)`
- **定时任务（可选，默认关闭）**：开启 `scheduleHold` 后每轮重扫调用宿主的 `schedule` 服务读取 `catalog()`，统计 `status === 'active'` 的任务，存在则保持唤醒。`schedule/changed` 事件发在 schedule 服务自身的上下文、cordis 事件只向上冒泡，本插件订阅不到，因此该判定依赖 5 秒轮询——新建任务最迟一个轮询周期内进入保温，删除/暂停任务最迟一个周期后进入宽限释放

dsh-keep-awake README · 工作原理：检测到活动时通过 `subprocess` 服务启动一个平台辅助进程（树级终止，进程退出即释放休眠标志）：

| 平台 | 机制 |
|---|---|
| Windows | PowerShell `SetThreadExecutionState(ES_CONTINUOUS \| ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED)`（勾选“同时阻止屏幕关闭”时加 `ES_DISPLAY_REQUIRED`） |
| macOS | `caffeinate [-d] -i -s` |
| Linux | `systemd-inhibit --what=idle --mode=block sleep 1e8` |

dsh-keep-awake README · 设置：设置页的改动通过 DSH 的 `settings` 服务写入 profile 的插件补丁（本插件自己的 Loader 行），重启后保留：

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `graceMs` | `60000` | 全部活动结束后的宽限期（15s–5m） |
| `preventDisplaySleep` | `false` | 同时阻止屏幕关闭 |
| `manualHold` | `false` | 手动保持唤醒 |
| `scheduleHold` | `false` | 存在待执行定时任务时保持唤醒。开启后设置页会显示待执行任务数与最近一次预定时间；宿主没有 `schedule` 服务时此项无效并在设置页提示 |
dsh-keep-awake README · 设置：这些字段在 `Config` 中都标记为 volatile，因此改动即时生效、不会重挂插件；每次修改都带修订号做乐观并发，两个设置页同时改时后改的一方会收到 409 并自动刷新为最新值。宿主没有 `settings` 服务时（例如老版本 DSH）设置页仍可操作，但改动只在本次运行内生效，界面会显示相应提示。

dsh-keep-awake README · 兼容性：| 项目 | 要求 |
|---|---|
| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0`（`engines.dsh`；开发验证于 `0.2.1-rc.2`，`scheduleHold` 及全量回归验证于 `0.2.1-rc.4`） |
| Node | `>=22` |
| `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` | `~3.18.5`（volatile 字段需要 3.18.5 起的 `.volatile()`，与宿主捆绑版本一致） |

`dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` 声明实际验证过的 `0.2.1-rc.2` 与 `0.2.1-rc.4`。`scheduleHold` 依赖宿主的 `schedule` 服务（0.2 线捆绑自带）；宿主没有该服务时选项惰性降级为无操作，设置页会提示。
dsh-keep-awake README · 多语言：界面使用框架 `locale` 服务（本插件的语言 namespace 为 `keep-awake`，zh/en 字典）：未显式设置语言时自动跟随浏览器/系统语言；在 DSH 语言设置中切换后即时生效（设置页正文与侧边栏标签均跟随）。

dsh-keep-awake README · HTTP 路由（loopback）：- `GET /dsh-keep-awake/state` — 当前状态（活动计数、定时任务保温视图（`pendingSchedules`/`nextDueAt`/`scheduleService`）、助手进程、配置，含 `revision` 与 `persistent`）
- `PUT /dsh-keep-awake/config` — 更新配置，body `{ "section": {...}, "revision": <可选> }`；修订号过期返回 `409` 并附最新状态、未知键返回 `400`

dsh-keep-awake README · dsh-keep-awake：<div align="center">

**Keep-awake plugin for the DeepSeek Harness (UI follows the DSH global language)**

Blocks OS sleep while any agent / subagent / background job runs · auto-release after a configurable grace period once idle · manual hold · optional display-on · optional: stay awake while scheduled tasks are pending · Windows / macOS / Linux · persisted settings · multilingual web settings page
dsh-keep-awake README · dsh-keep-awake：[](https://github.com/bearice/dsh-keep-awake) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) **English** | [中文](README.md)

dsh-keep-awake README · Features：| Feature | Where | Details |
|---|---|---|
| Live status | Settings → Keep Awake | Status badge (Keeping awake / Grace Ns / Standby / Disabled / Helper error), running agent count, background job count, helper platform + PID |
| Activity detection | — | Running agents (main agent / subagents / workflow children) + running background jobs (`run_in_background` commands / background subagent tasks) |
| Grace period | Configurable | Automatically releases keep-awake 15s–5m (default 60s) after everything finishes |
| Manual hold | Settings page | Force-keep awake regardless of activity; click to release |
| Keep display on | Optional | By default only system sleep is blocked (display may turn off); opt in to keep the display on too |
| Scheduled-task hold | Optional, off by default | While enabled and any scheduled task is pending (status `active`), the wake lock is held so due tasks always fire; released through the grace period once tasks are cleared |
| Localization | Global | Follows the DSH global language (zh/en); auto-detects the browser/system language when unset; switches instantly (including the sidebar label) |
dsh-keep-awake README · How it works：Polls every 5 seconds, with instant re-scan on events (`agent/status`, `subagent/start|end`, job set changes):

dsh-keep-awake README · How it works：- **Running agents**: agents with `status === 'running'` in `agents.list()` (covers the main agent, subagents, and workflow children)
- **Background jobs**: `running`/`stopping` jobs from `jobs.list()` (unowned) plus `jobs.list(sessionId)` for every live session (covers `run_in_background` commands and background subagent tasks); job events come from `jobs.events.subscribe({ owners: 'all' }, ...)`
- **Scheduled tasks (optional, off by default)**: with `scheduleHold` enabled, each rescan reads the Host `schedule` service's `catalog()` and counts tasks with `status === 'active'`; any pending task keeps the lock held. `schedule/changed` fires on the schedule service's own context and cordis events only bubble upward, so this plugin cannot subscribe — detection rides the 5 s poll: a newly created task arms the hold within one poll, deletions/pauses release through the grace period within one poll

dsh-keep-awake README · How it works：When activity is detected, a platform helper process is started via the `subprocess` service (tree-level termination — the sleep flags release as soon as the process exits):

| Platform | Mechanism |
|---|---|
| Windows | PowerShell `SetThreadExecutionState(ES_CONTINUOUS \| ES_SYSTEM_REQUIRED)` (adds `ES_DISPLAY_REQUIRED` when "keep display on" is enabled) |
| macOS | `caffeinate [-d] -i -s` |
| Linux | `systemd-inhibit --what=idle --mode=block sleep 1e8` |
dsh-keep-awake README · Settings：Changes made on the settings page are written through DSH's `settings` service into the profile's plugin patch (this plugin's own Loader row) and survive a restart:

dsh-keep-awake README · Settings：| Key | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch |
| `graceMs` | `60000` | Grace period after all activity ends (15s–5m) |
| `preventDisplaySleep` | `false` | Also keep the display on |
| `manualHold` | `false` | Manual hold |
| `scheduleHold` | `false` | Stay awake while scheduled tasks are pending. When enabled the settings page shows the pending count and the next due time; on a host without the `schedule` service the option is inert and the page says so |

dsh-keep-awake README · Settings：All of these fields are marked volatile in `Config`, so a change applies live without remounting the plugin. Every write carries a revision for optimistic concurrency: if two settings pages write at once, the later one gets a 409 and reloads the live values. On a host without a `settings` service (older DSH) the page still works, but changes last only until DSH restarts and the UI says so.

dsh-keep-awake README · Compatibility：| Item | Requirement |
|---|---|
| DSH | `>=0.2.0-rc.1 <0.3.0-0` (`engines.dsh`; developed against `0.2.1-rc.2`, `scheduleHold` and the full regression verified against `0.2.1-rc.4`) |
| Node | `>=22` |
| `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` | `~3.18.5` (volatile fields need `.volatile()`, added in 3.18.5; same range the host bundles) |

dsh-keep-awake README · Compatibility：`dsh.compatibility.dshReleases` declares the releases actually verified: `0.2.1-rc.2` and `0.2.1-rc.4`. `scheduleHold` relies on the Host's `schedule` service (bundled with every 0.2-line host); on a host without it the option degrades to a no-op and the settings page says so.

dsh-keep-awake README · Localization：The UI uses the framework `locale` service (this plugin's locale namespace is `keep-awake`, zh/en dictionaries): when no language is explicitly set, the browser/system language is used; switching in DSH's language settings takes effect instantly (both the settings page body and the sidebar label follow).

dsh-keep-awake README · HTTP routes (loopback)：- `GET /dsh-keep-awake/state` — current state (activity counts, schedule-hold view (`pendingSchedules` / `nextDueAt` / `scheduleService`), helper process, config, plus `revision` and `persistent`)
- `PUT /dsh-keep-awake/config` — update config, body `{ "section": {...}, "revision": <optional> }`; a stale revision returns `409` with the live state, an unknown key returns `400`
